items.headline: New Zealand third-quarter inflation slows to 3.7% but expectations remain of a hike next week
items.summary: WELLINGTON, Oct 22 (Reuters) - New Zealand's annual inflation slowed in the third quarter, coming in below analysts' forecasts at 3.7%, but remained above the top end of the central bank's target range, official data showed on Thursday, as data adds to expectations the central bank will hike rate...
